text:
Mina, you need someone who can take ownership of Amazon PPC across Europe and the USA, keep ACOS under control, and provide clear weekly reporting without needing micromanagement.

I have 5 years’ experience in data analysis and dashboarding, and I’ve built reporting systems that improve decision-making fast. For Marlowe Furniture, I built a Power BI sales dashboard on a star-schema model replacing 14 Excel reports, which cut monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. For Coastline Hardware, I built a Power Query workbook that matched warehouse counts to ERP data weekly and found $86k of stock variance.

My tools are SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, and data cleaning/visualization workflows. I can review your Excel Ad report, comment on what can be improved, and provide weekly reports plus a call every 2 weeks. I can commit 10–15 hours per week and start at the end of February.
